about: This bundle includes: ·Dead Cells Base Game, with the Rise of the Giant DLC update.
·Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania DLC Slay countless foes in fast-paced combat with action roguelite Dead Cells and storm Dracula's Castle with classic weapons in the Return to Castlevania DLC!

Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.
Explore a sprawling, ever-changing island, challenging hordes of enemies in fast-paced, buttery smooth 2D combat.
· 17 Levels —Each one with its own atmosphere, foes and secrets to discover.
· 5 Bosses — Made by the most sadistic of the devs, raised on the salt of the testers.
summary: Play the award-winning roguelite Dead Cells and its Return to Castlevania DLC!
